headline: Central Bank of India Files Complaint Over ₹13.97 Crore Unauthorized Transfers
summary: Central Bank of India reported ₹13.97 crore in unauthorized transfers from its RBI settlement account to 36 banks following a suspected breach involving IFTAS's Central SFMS server.
why: Core interbank settlement systems underpin Indian financial market infrastructure; payment system security breaches trigger strict central bank regulatory oversight.

impacts.name: Central Bank of India
impacts.why: Unauthorized transaction breaches risk direct financial losses and invite heightened supervisory scrutiny from the RBI.
